assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is performed with CPT code 93229
The member has known sick sinus syndrome
The member has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The member has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate control management
The member has prior cerebrovascular events coded Z86.73
Prior approval is required for coverage eligibility under SilverBridge Advantage's policy for this procedure
